## 1a21a4a82b48

**Source binding:** generator SHA-256
`09637fd920633cc961faaa5a5b7eb5317e8edb441396d8d39653385e631ce014`;
executed canonical rule hash `15a674f4db43`.

**A2 — Reproduced teaching shortcut.** A plausible rival says: among candidate
objects with the same cell count as the red source, select the lowest-color
candidate, crop it, and recolor it cyan. At difficulty `easy`, seed `2`,
consecutive sample indices `0,1,2` all make that shortcut choose the intended
candidate, so it matches all demonstrations. At sample index `3`, the intended
target has color `9` while the rival chooses color `6`, and their query outputs
differ.

The exact query input, rival output, and actual protected-Racket output are:

- `checks/audit/1a21a4a82b48/input.json`
- `checks/audit/1a21a4a82b48/rival_output.json`
- `checks/audit/1a21a4a82b48/racket.json`
- `checks/audit/1a21a4a82b48/confirmation.json`

The target validator accepts the input. The Racket output equals the intended
shape output and differs from the rival. The reusable search is
`checks/audit/1a21a4a82b48/size_shortcut_ambiguity_probe.py`.

A broader diagnostic over seed `0..99` and sample indices `0..3` found that the
size shortcut alone uniquely selects the intended target in 199/400 easy,
228/400 medium, and 231/400 hard individual pairs. These per-pair rates do not
by themselves measure complete lesson ambiguity; the exact four-pair window
above is the actionable reproducer. See
`checks/audit/1a21a4a82b48/size_shortcut_probe.json`.

**Tooling/contract findings.** The audit preset completed both requested stages
and failed: no task-local or selected frozen tests were found, and the semantic
gate reports no contract. A partial strict battery also reports missing required
`RULE_HASH` and two singleton/inert advertised axes (`position_bias` and
`density`). Direct override probes at seed `17`, sample index `23`, medium found
candidate-count, palette-size, distinct-color-count, and palette-kind variants
produced identical grids to each other and to the no-override call.

Evidence: `checks/audit/1a21a4a82b48-audit-1/result.json`,
`checks/audit/1a21a4a82b48-audit-1/checks/1a21a4a82b48_audit_summary.json`, and
`checks/audit/1a21a4a82b48-battery-1/checks/1a21a4a82b48_audit_lint.log`.
The partial battery was interrupted outside the completed audit preset and is
not reported as an aggregate battery verdict. No fix was attempted.
